DefaultDescriptionFormat.SourceString:
Nature runes are used for casting transmutation spells. 

Runes are retained if you happen to die.
DefaultDescriptionFormat.LocalizedString:
Nature runes are used for casting transmutation spells. 

Runes are retained if you happen to die.

Description.SourceString: Contrary to popular belief, the nature rune does not solely govern plants, roots and the natural world. That is only part of its design. Instead, nature is about the connection of things, threading together the way things could be, rewriting them to a state more desirable. Favoured by wizard’s for their ability to adjust the flow of time to an entity, dragging it back to a point when it was in a more preferable state.
